hints.title: Distinct Starting Points
hints.text: Every chosen substring must begin with a distinct character.

hints.title: Unique Character Upper Bound
hints.text: The maximum number of distinct starting characters cannot exceed the number of unique characters in string s.

hints.title: Constructive Choice
hints.text: Selecting single-character substrings for each unique character in s achieves this upper bound trivially.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: number of unique characters in s
complexity.notes: Counting unique characters via hash set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all substring combinations results in exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(U) memory bounded by character set size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the upper bound equals the count of unique characters in the string.
